optimizer.backend: shared scipy Powell with native convergence; real candidate cap independent of cache calls
optimizer.early_stop: Immediately on first full measured acceptance, then independent endpoint remeasurement; no forced budget exhaustion.
optimizer.loss: normalized log f0 and Q errors squared, power excess squared*100, PM and pass/stop dB deficits squared; 1000 per remaining hard scalar gate violation; 10000 if stability not true; invalid measurement 1e9
optimizer.finite_budget_limitation: 120 real new full-circuit evaluations plus one independent endpoint. Cache hits do not consume the real evaluation allowance. Native convergence or first full feasibility may stop earlier. This cap is not a guarantee of global convergence.

common_acceptance.stability_scope: pinned SKY130 tt model and measured DC point; full closed-loop numerical small-signal check plus finite step recovery
common_acceptance.phase_margin_scope: Tian two-port output return diagnostic, not sole full stability gate
